title: Non-current Assets Held for Sale and Discontinued Operations
summary: Prescribes the classification, measurement and presentation of non-current assets (or disposal groups) held for sale and discontinued operations, one of the most closely converged Ind AS standards relative to IFRS 5.

bannerNotice.title: Ind AS — Closely Converged with IFRS 5
bannerNotice.body: Ind AS 105 is one of the MOST closely converged Ind AS standards, with only NARROW, largely terminological or interpretive carve-outs relative to IFRS 5. Section 11 covers the full comparison.
